translationJa.summaryJa: 任務は作戦“INHERENT RESOLVE”のISRで、発信部隊は12 SOS、作戦センターは609th。航空機（識別符号は赤acted（b)(1)1.4a）は200823ZにOJMSからSLR経由で離陸。1102Zに37S FV 85 81でFMV/SIGINT収集、1230Zに37S FU 36 79でFMV/SIGINT収集、2318Zに37S FU 85 81で追加のFMV/SIGINT収集を実施。ミッション合計20時間24分、FMV稼働14時間22分（FMVタスキング3件）、SIGINT合計13時間2分（SIGINTタスキング3件）。気象は快晴、任務成果は“SATISFACTORY”、情報ギャップは埋められたと報告。ISR活動の詳細として、1102Z到着時に3機のADMと1台のMOTOを観測、1230Z到着時は車両1台を観測し1230–1313ZはEYES FREE、1313–1410Zに1機のADM搭載MOTOに対して3回のストップフォロー、1447–1518Zにも別のADMに対して3回のストップフォローと出発を観測。1559Zに未同定到来現象（UAP）を観測（201559Z）。UAPはFMVカメラ映像上に原因不明の光／グレアが走る現象として記録され、乗員はレーザー照射ではないと評価し無害（benign）と判断。観測に対するUAPの反応はなく、第三者観測や機器への影響、回収物は報告されていない。
translationJa.summaryEn: The report documents an ISR mission for Operation INHERENT RESOLVE (originator: 12 SOS; operations center: 609th). The aircraft (callsign redacted as (b)(1)1.4a) departed OJMS via SLR at 200823Z. On-station activity: 1102Z at 37S FV 85 81 for FMV/SIGINT collection; 1230Z at 37S FU 36 79 for FMV/SIGINT collection; 2318Z at 37S FU 85 81 for additional FMV/SIGINT collection. Mission totals: 20:24 mission hours; 14:22 FMV hours (3 FMV taskings); 13:02 SIGINT hours (3 SIGINT taskings). Weather: clear. Reported effectiveness: satisfactory; intel gaps filled. ISR details: at 1102Z observed 3 ADMs and 1 MOTO; at 1230Z observed 1 vehicle, 1230–1313Z eyes-free pending SI, 1313–1410Z conducted three stop-follows on one ADM mounted MOTO, and 1447–1518Z conducted three stop-follows on one ADM in traditional wear before departure; no further EEI activity until retasking at 2252Z. A UAP was observed at 1559Z (initial contact 201559Z): described as a light/glare of unknown origin flashing across the FMV camera feed. The UAP showed no response to observer actions; aircrew assessed the event was not a lasing incident and considered it benign. No third-party observations, personnel or equipment impacts, or recoveries were reported.

translationJa.summaryJa: ISR任務（ATO: 1.4a）を行った単機（コールサインは秘匿）が2023-10-26 23:39ZにLGLRを発航し、10-27に現場で支援任務を実施。0342Zにオンステーション、1011Zにオフステーション、13:09ZにOJMS着陸。総飛行時間13時間30分、FMV稼働時間6時間29分。搭載センサーはFMV/シギント、TGTポッドAN/DAS-4、データリンクLINK 16等。任務はターゲット開発（パターン・オブ・ライフ、経路解析、人・車両交通の特定）で、FMVはGETにより解析済み。2023-10-27 00:35Zに海面上を飛行する小型と思われるUAPを1機観測（円形に見え、詳細不明）、複数回90度旋回、推定速度約80mph。0038Zに映像を失い追跡不能となった。報告は被支援部隊や一部連絡先を秘匿している。
translationJa.summaryEn: A single ISR aircraft (callsign redacted) on ATO 1.4a departed LGLR on 26 Oct 2023 at 2339Z, on-station at 270342Z, off-station at 271011Z, and landed at OJMS at 271309Z. Total mission time was 13:30, with 6:29 FMV hours. Sensors/gear included FMV/SIGINT, AN/DAS-4 target pod, AWGMESH, and LINK 16. The mission supported masked tasking for target development (pattern-of-life, route analysis, characterization of human/vehicle traffic); FMV was exploited by GET. At 270035Z (27 Oct) the crew observed one possible UAP: small, seemingly circular, flying just above the ocean surface, made multiple sharp 90-degree turns at an estimated 80 mph, and was lost from the feed at 0038Z. Certain unit and contact details are redacted.

translationJa.summaryJa: 33 SOS発のISR任務（機体/コールサインは秘匿）はLGLRから離陸（DTG 281504Z OCT23）し、オンステーションは281018Z OCT23到着、290542Z OCT23離脱で総ミッション時間20時間01分、オンステーション時間9時間24分。主センサーはFMV（補助にG‑MESH）、任務はターゲット開発/監視で、指定点（座標は秘匿）でFMV/SIGINT収集を実施。到着後は2019Z–2243Zに複数の関連COIをポーリングしたがEEIは観測されず、2244Zに駐車場屋上で車両6台を確認、人員は確認されなかった。FMVはGETにより解析され、任務は“Intel Gap Filled: Yes / Satisfactory”。UAP事象はDTG 290811Z OCT23に発生。RIB搭乗者が海面上すぐを飛行する小型でほぼ円形の物体を視認し陸側へ飛行、同時刻に映像フィードで追跡不能となった。報告上の評価は「良性（Benign）」、物理状態は“固体”、推進方式は不明、推定速度30 MPH、センサー署名や機材への影響は記載なし。
translationJa.summaryEn: An ISR sortie originating from 33 SOS (aircraft/callsign masked) departed LGLR (DTG 281504Z OCT23). On-station from 282018Z OCT23 to 290542Z OCT23; total mission time 20:01, on-station time 9:24. Primary sensor was FMV (with G‑MESH available); tasked for target development/collection at a masked start point where FMV/SIGINT collection was conducted. From 2019Z–2243Z the crew polled several associated COIs with no EEI observed; at 2244Z they observed six vehicles on a parking‑garage rooftop with no personnel. FMV was exploited by GET; effectiveness noted as “Intel Gap Filled: Yes / Satisfactory.” A UAP event occurred at 290811Z OCT23: RIB personnel observed a small, seemingly circular object flying just above the ocean toward land and it was lost from the feed at the same time. Reported assessment: benign; physical state solid; propulsion unknown; estimated kinetic velocity 30 MPH; no signatures or effects on equipment reported. Tasking details and many identifiers are masked.

translationJa.summaryJa: ヒューストン管制（CC）と宇宙船側（インテレピッド＝CDR/LM、ヤンキー・クリッパー＝CMP）間の交信記録。E-MOD準備完了、コンピュータ制御の切替（P00/ACCEPT）やアップリンクの受信、打ち上げ時刻142:03:47の通知が行われた。ヤンキー・クリッパーはバッテリー充電をこのパスのLOSで終了するよう指示を受け了承。乗員はAOTで光の粒子が観察されると報告し、いくつかは月を離脱するように見えると述べる。ヤンキー・クリッパーへはP22追跡PADが送られ、ターゲットはLMと伝達。インテレピッド側でAGSの表示が「オール8」のパルスを示す現象が発生し、トラブルはEMIの可能性が示唆された。RCSのホットファイア許可、ロール・ピッチ・ヨーのデータ送信、テレビ（VOX）準備、機内の掃除状況などの通常運用確認も含まれる。追跡灯については乗員が消灯を疑う一方で電流監視では点灯を示すと報告されている。
translationJa.summaryEn: Transcription of communications between Houston (CC) and spacecraft (Intrepid CDR/LMP, Yankee Clipper CMP). E-MOD readiness confirmed; computer control handovers (P00/ACCEPT) and an uplink were coordinated. Launch time was given as 142:03:47. Yankee Clipper was instructed and agreed to terminate a battery charge at LOS for this pass. Crew reported seeing particles/lights through the AOT, some appearing to depart the Moon. A P22 tracking PAD was uplinked to Yankee Clipper designating the LM as the target. The Intrepid AGS displayed pulsing all-8s on address and information registers; flight and ground personnel suggested EMI as a possible cause. RCS hot-fire was approved, roll/pitch/yaw data were sent, TV (VOX) was being readied, and cabin sweepdown improved cleanliness. There was a discrepancy about a tracking light—crew thought it had burned out while electrical monitoring indicated it was on.

translationJa.summaryJa: ミッションコントロールはマヌーバ開始時刻を03:33:27、S‑IVB分離(SEP)を03+43に予定すると連絡。キャビン圧は5.9と報告された。操縦中に乗組員は窓外に多数の明るい粒子・破片を観察し、形はギザギザで薄片状、回転やきらめきがあり、大きいものは約6インチ程度と推定、相対運動はほとんどなく一部に速い破片もあると説明した。原因として氷塊や塗装剥離の可能性が挙がり、写真（Frame 65, 70, 50など）を撮影。分離手順ではSECS/TRANS/pyro等を装備・確認し、GDCアライン、DET開始、LAUNCH VEHICLE SEPボタン操作、MCをAUTOにして分離を実施した。後半（02:18以降）では別の遠方にあると思われる周期的に明暗を繰り返すフラッシュ状の物体を観察し、それは近傍の粒子とは異なると述べられ、NOUN 20などを使って方位・姿勢参照で位置同定を試みる旨のやり取りがあった。その他、ALFMEDの収納、LOIアボートチャートの長いアップデート、地球の天気観察や雑談（スポーツ結果など）も含まれる。
translationJa.summaryEn: Mission Control advised a maneuver start at 03:33:27 and planned S‑IVB separation at 03+43; cabin pressure was reported at 5.9. During the maneuver the crew observed numerous bright particles/fragments outside the windows—described as jagged, flake‑like, sometimes tumbling and twinkling, with some pieces estimated up to ~6 inches; most showed little relative motion though occasional higher‑velocity fragments were seen. Possible causes mentioned included ice chunks or peeling paint; the crew took photos (Frames 65, 70, 50). Separation procedures were carried out with SECS/TRANS/pyros armed, GDC align, DET initiated, LAUNCH VEHICLE SEP button pressed and MC set to AUTO. Later (02:18+), the crew reported a separate, more distant object producing regular bright and dim flashes, distinct from the nearby particles, and discussed using NOUN 20 and attitude marks to attempt positional identification. The transcript also records ALFMED stowage, a forthcoming LOI abort‑chart update, Earth weather observations, and informal banter.

translationJa.summaryJa: アポロ11乗組員の技術的ブリーフィング（1969年7月31日）抜粋。乗組員（コリンズ、アームストロング、オルドリン）は月軌道到着前に十分な休息を取り、LM分離を飛行計画の開始と考える心構えが重要だと述べている。視覚観測では、月接近時に近傍に比較的大きな不明物体を観測。単眼鏡や光学具で見ると、ピントにより中空円筒や「開いた本」状に見え、回転しているように見えたが、距離・大きさは不明。S-IVBやハイゲインアンテナ片、マイラー等宇宙船由来の可能性が議論されたが結論は出ていない。また、キャビン内で数分間隔に発生する小さな閃光（単発・二重・線状）をオルドリンが観察。入射と衝突のように見えることがあり、静電気と比較し差異を認めた。太陽方向との関連が示唆され、頻度は概ね1分に1回程度と報告。地球帰還時には火星像の錯視や、地球側からの非常に明るい反射（当初はレーザーと推定、後に湖面の太陽反射と再評価）も触れられている。
translationJa.summaryEn: Excerpt from Apollo 11 crew technical debriefing (31 July 1969). Crew members (Collins, Armstrong, Aldrin) emphasize entering lunar orbit well-rested and treating LM separation as the start of the mission phase. Visual sightings: near the Moon they observed a relatively large unidentified object; through monoculars/optics it appeared either as a hollow cylinder or an "open-book" shape depending on focus, and seemed to tumble. Range and size were unknown. They considered S‑IVB, spacecraft debris (Mylar, panel), or high-gain antenna parts as possible origins but reached no firm conclusion. Aldrin reported repeated small flashes inside the cabin over successive nights—single, double, or linear flashes sometimes appearing as an entry and subsequent impact; he distinguished these from small static sparks and noted a possible correlation with the Sun's direction. Frequency was roughly on the order of one per minute. Additionally, they noted a translunar/transearth optical illusion involving Mars and a very bright Earth-based reflection initially thought to be a laser but later interpreted as sunlight glinting off a lake.

translationJa.summaryJa: アポロ17のブリーフィングで、Henryは観測結果を報告している。コマ銀河団がイオン化水素（赤方偏移したライマンα放射）によって結合しているという仮説は観測で否定された。高銀緯方向の紫外線観測では、視野内に高温星はないにもかかわらず高温星に似たスペクトルが得られ、最も保守的には銀河面の高温星光が星間塵で散乱されたものと解釈されるが、一部の特徴は合致せず銀河外放射の可能性もあるため詳細な計算解析が必要とされる。第五点として、ライマンα水素放射は別問題で、コロラド大のGary ThomasらがOGO-5で観測しており、アポロで得た大量のデータが同現象（太陽系内の水素が太陽光を反射している、Thomasは星間由来の流入水素と見ている）の解明に寄与すると期待されている。最後に、外部から見た地球のスペクトルについても観測が行われたと述べている。
translationJa.summaryEn: In the Apollo 17 debriefing Henry reports observational results. They found no red‑shifted Lyman‑alpha radiation from ionized hydrogen, ruling out ionized hydrogen as the binding agent for the Coma cluster. UV observations at high galactic latitudes produced a spectrum resembling a hot star despite no hot stars in the field; the conservative interpretation is scattered light from hot stars in the galactic plane off interstellar dust, though some spectral features do not fit and an extragalactic origin remains possible—detailed computer analysis is required. Fifth, Lyman‑alpha hydrogen is treated separately: Gary Thomas and Charles Barthum observed it from OGO‑5, and Apollo returned a large dataset expected to clarify this—interpreted as sunlight reflected from hydrogen inside the solar system, possibly interstellar hydrogen streaming through. He also notes observations of the Earth's spectrum from outside.

after the brightness of the fireball decreased, I could look
back up through the rendezvous window and see what to me was

The only unusual sighting I can recall during landing or

Well, it was kind of foggy on the windows.

had light flashes just about continuously during the whole

translationJa.fullTextJa: NASA有人宇宙船センターのApollo 17技術クルー・デブリーフィング。1973年1月4日、訓練オフィスおよびクルー訓練・シミュレーション部門によって作成された文書で、公開から90日後に自動的に機密解除される旨と、FOIAに基づく公開制限の可能性が記されている。抜粋部分では、Evansが火球の明るさが下がった後、ランデブー窓から見返すと、中央に明るい点があるトンネルのようなものが見え、その奥に火球が見えたと述べる。Cernanは、着陸または回収時の唯一の珍しい視認として、CMPが窓の外を見て航空母艦の上部構造物を見つけ、「tin canが一緒にいる」と言った場面を挙げる。Evansは窓が曇っていたと補足する。Schmittは地球帰還中、地球は小さな三日月状で広範な気象観測は現実的ではなかったと述べる。また、暗順応している間は飛行中ほぼ継続的に光の閃光があり、月面上の閃光だと思ったものも一度あったと説明する。ALFMED実験で目隠しをしていた時間帯には見える閃光がなく、その夜寝る前には再び光の閃光が見えるようになったため、その前後の短い間だけ自分や他の2人には閃光が見えなかったようだと述べている。

KERWIN     Unusual or Unexpected Visual Phenomenon.  We saw light flashes.
(CONT'D)
           I think all of us saw them.  I saw them most often when I was

           in the sack at night with my eyes closed but awake naturally.

           They tended to wax and wane in frequency.  Someone asked me if

           that was in conjunction with the South Atlantic anomaly.  It

           may have been.  I didn't have the pad with me at that time and

           I don't know.  They were numerous at times - two or three per

           minute.


CONRAD     Some of them to me were a spot or sunbursts.  Some were streaks.

           The streaks, in my case, were less frequent than the bursts.

           Most of them were in my peripheral visual field.  Very few in

           the central visual field.  I don't know why.


QUERY      You could isolate them to one eye, couldn't you?


KERWIN     No, I couldn't.


WEITZ      I would say mine were primarily in the left eye for some

           reason.


CONRAD     You have to concentrate but you can determine they are in one

           eye.


KERWIN     I did not.  That was foolish of me but I didn't try.  I'm sure

           they are in one eye.



                                   23-20

[Page 3] [[page 3 confidence: 97]]

          see a fire sensor wink.

KERWIN    And you'd have to be careful that you weren't confusing that
          with the fire flash.  Once you've seen a few of each, there is
          question of which is which.  They're not an hallucination.

KERWIN    We didn't feel it was operationally necessary for anybody to
          know about it right now.

WEITZ     I had a couple that I thought were cosmic particles.  I saw
          an entrance streak and an exit streak.

CONRAD    Yes, I did too.

WEITZ     Where, bing-bing, it seemed like it was one side of the eyeball,
          and then the other side.

CONRAD    One night I remember that there was a long shot then it was
          blank then there was a long shot in rapid succession, of
          course, but very definitely in and out - or across the eye.

KERWIN    Medical Kits and IMSS.  As far as adequate quantity of medica-

BEAN          I did too.  The sack would move over in the corner.

LOUSMA        Things we saw out the window.

GARRIOTT      For example, we saw that satellite about a week before splash-
              down.  That was one of the most unusual things that we saw
              and I guess Jack noticed it looking out the window.  This
              bright reddish object was out there and we tracked it for
              about 5 or 10 minutes.  It was obviously a satellite in a very
              similar orbit to our own.  It was rotating and had a period
              of almost exactly 10 seconds because you could see the bright-
              ness vary with that period.  We followed it until sunset and
              it went out of sunlight just about 5 to 7 seconds after we
              did.  It held its position nearly the same, in the wardroom
              window for that 10-minute interval although we could see it
              drift in relative positions slightly, maybe 10 to - 20 degrees
              during the course of that 10-minute interval.  It was reddish
              in color even when we were well above the horizon.  As we
              approached sunset, it turned more reddish, presumably because
            . of the sunlight change.  What satellite it was and how it
              happened to end up in such a similar orbit, no one ever explained
              to us.  And I would like to hear a few words from someone about
              that satellite.


                                    7-4

[Page 6] [[page 6 confidence: 97]]
BEAN        You bet.  We never saw it again.  You'd think we would have
            seen it the next night or it would cycle by another time.
            Maybe it did and we weren't looking out the window.

LOUSMA      You might point out that it never did take the shape of an
            object but it was always brighter than any other star or
            planet in the night sky.  It was much brighter.

BEAN        We tried monitors and everything on it but we could never
            make it into anything other than a bright light.

LOUSMA      In doing T002, I had on other occasions, at least once or
            twice, seen other satellites although they appeared as star
            points of light.

BEAN        Let's talk about caution/warnings at night and in the daytime.
            I noticed at first when we did have caution/warnings in the
            daytime we all whistled up there real quick to see what was
            happening.  Then as the mission wore on, we tended to just let
            whoever was closest take a look.  Without the TACS on, there
            isn't a lot that can go on except rapid DELTA-P which sounds
            different than any of the other caution/warnings, particularly
            just a caution.  I recommend to Jerry and his crew, and I'm
            sure that this recommendation will be hard to live by, that
            caution/warnings don't appear to be anything you have to hurry
            and resolve or stop doing your tasks to race up to the panel

                                    7-5

[Page 7] [[page 7 confidence: 96]]
20.0  VISUAL SIGHTINGS

LOUSMA      Let's talk about visual sightings.  Any comments on countdown.
            You saw your way to the booster or you didn't see that.
            Visual sighting no problem there.

BEAN        You might want to talk about the visual sightings on that
            orbit when Owen and Jack saw the satellite.

LOUSMA      Yes, let's go through countdown.  Any visual sightings on
            countdown that were significant?  We saw the swing arm go
            away and all that kind of thing.

            Powered Flight:  I watched the booster protector cover go
            off and lots of flashes and debris and everything in every
            separation, but that's all norminal.  During orbit: -

GARRIOTT    Do you want to talk about that satellite?

LOUSMA      I saw a couple of satellites that appeared like a satellite
            would on the Earth.  I saw one that was not like one you
            would see on Earth, so why don't you mention it.

GARRIOTT    Okay, about a week or 10 days before recovery and we were
            still waiting for information to be supplied to us about the
            indentification.  Jack first noticed this rather large red star
            out the wardroom window.  Upon close examination, it was much
            brighter than Jupiter or any of the other planets.  It had

                              20-1

[Page 8] [[page 8 confidence: 97]]
GARRIOTT    a reddish hue to it, even though it was well above the
(CONT'D)
            horizon.  The light from the Sun was not passing close to
            the Earth's limb at the time.  We observed it for about
            10 minutes prior to sunset.  It was slowly rotating because
            it had a variation in brightness with a 10-second period.
            As I was saying, we observed it for about 10 minutes, until
            we went into darkness, and it also followed us into darkness
            about 5-seconds later.  From the 5- to 10-second delay in
            it's disappearance we surmised that it was not more than 30
            to 50 nautical miles from our location.  From it's original
            position in the wardroom window, it did not move more than
            10 or 20 degrees over the 10 minutes or so that we watched it.
            It's orbit was very close to that of our own.  We never saw
            it on any - earlier or succeeding orbits and we'd be quite
            interested in having its identification established.  It's
            all debriefed in terms of time on channel A, so the percise
            timing and location can be picked up from there.

LOUSMA      Okay, other visual sightings was the one out the wardroom

            RCS leak in the command module.  It disappeared like
            thousands and thousands of stars out there; all of them
            different sizes and drifting along the X-axis.  The one that

GIBSON   are still on the windows.  Just what that material is, I'm not
(CONT'D)
         sure.  But the remaining pieces should be useful for contamina-

         tion studies.

CARR     One other item is the ammonia odor in the head which we dis-

         covered about the last week in the mission.  We weren't sure what

         was causing it.  Bill had changed out the charcoal canister.

         We disconnected the boot between the charcoal canister and the

         blower above it and took a sniff of that.  We smelled, no ammonia

         there.  When we connected the boot back up to the blower, a

         very strong ammonia odor came from the blower output.  Thus it

         appears that the source of the smell was the blower unit itself

         and not the charcoal canister.  As we said in our report of it

         to the ground, we decided that it was tolerable for the rest of

         the mission.  Therefore, we didn't get into the mode of finding

         another blower to put in there.  I feel that the odor very

         definitely increased in intensity during the final week of the

         mission.

CARR     One other area of unusual events that we reported on the dump

         tapes was that on occasion we saw some lights flashing outside

         with very a definite motion relative to ours.  We presumed that

         they were other pieces of Skylab, or possibly other satellites.

         We reported our two or three sightings of that kind as soon as

         they occurred.  We have no special comments concerning them,

                              7-8

[Page 11] [[page 11 confidence: 97]]
CARR     but we did find it very interesting to be able to see other
(CONT'D)
         objects up there with us.  The fact that one or two of them
         appeared to be tumbling was apparently due to the oscillation
         of the light flashes that we were getting from them.

POGUE    The OWS Heat Exchangers:  There's a major design flaw there in
         that filters were not installed upstream of the OWS heat exchanger
         vanes.  When we first arrived, the vanes were so uniformly coated
         with lint that I thought there was some kind of anodized surface
         on them.  I was never fully convinced that I had done the
         vacumming job properly; therefore, I fabricated a special tool
         that fit flush against those surface vanes so that I could
         exert a good vacuum.  Though they are not supposed to be con-
         densive heat exchangers, I sucked quite a bit of condensate water
         out of them.  I tried the best I could to keep those things
         clean, yet I never did get all that lint pulled out of there.
         That is why I think we needed a filter in the system.

GIBSON   EVA anomalies might also be mentioned here.  For example, you
         had the water leak outside, and I also got a water leak.

POGUE    One thing that was not mentioned on air-to-ground as a possible
         cause of the problem was the single-point failure that exists
         in the mechanical way that the PCU composite connector is
         hooked to the PCU.  I was able during EVA, maneuvering through
         the clothesline ropes, not only to open the lock but also to
         extend the arm which pulls the PCU composite connector off.

                                  7-9

translationJa.summaryJa: 複数のSkylab乗組員の技術デブリーフィング（文書の日付：1973-06-30、1973-10-04、1974-02-22）に関する要約。夜間に乗組員全員が目撃した光の閃光（頻度は増減、時に1分に2–3回）。閃光は点やサンバースト、線状の痕跡として現れ、多くは周辺視野で観察され、一部は片眼優位（左眼など）として報告、入口・出口の痕跡により宇宙線粒子と考えられる事例もあった。火災センサーの点滅と混同し得るが幻覚ではないとされた。医療キットは十分で、使用量は極めて少なく（約0.01% と報告）。視覚的目撃では、着水約1週間前に非常に明るい赤みを帯びた衛星状の物体を10分程度追跡（回転周期約10秒、我々の消灯より5–7秒遅れて消失、相対位置変化は約10–20度、同軌道に近いと推定）したが同定されていない。他にもスカイラブ残骸や他衛星と推定される相対運動を示す物体を数回観察。投入直後や日の出／日の入り時に見られた星の消失やX軸方向の流れはCMのRCSリークの目視指標になった。窓に残る破片は汚染研究に有用。便所でのアンモニア臭はミッション最終週に顕著化し、活性炭カートリッジではなくブロワー本体が発生源と推定された。OWS熱交換器では上流にフィルタがなく、ベーンが糸くずで覆われていたため専用工具で掃除して水分を除去し、フィルタの必要性が指摘された。EVAでは外部での水漏れが発生し、PCUのコンポジット・コネクタの固定方法に単一故障点があり、EVA中に取り外され得る懸念が報告された。
translationJa.summaryEn: Summaries of Skylab crew technical debriefings (dates: 30 June 1973, 4 Oct 1973, 22 Feb 1974). Crew reported unusual visual phenomena: light flashes at night (frequency variable, at times 2–3 per minute). Flashes appeared as spots, sunbursts, or streaks, often in peripheral vision; some reports indicated one-eye predominance (e.g., left eye). Some sightings included entrance and exit streaks consistent with cosmic particle events. Fire-sensor winks were seen and could be confused with these flashes; crew judged them non-hallucinatory and not operationally urgent. Medical supplies were adequate; estimated medication use was about 0.01% of available stock. A notably bright reddish satellite-like object was tracked from the wardroom window about one week before splashdown for ~10 minutes; it rotated with ~10-second brightness variation, disappeared 5–7 seconds after the crew, drifted ~10–20 degrees, and appeared in a very similar orbit but was never identified. Other objects showing clear relative motion (possible Skylab debris or other satellites) were reported two or three times; some appeared to be tumbling. Visual observations of many stars disappearing or streaming along the X-axis contributed to detection of an RCS leak in the command module; RCS plume was also seen after insertion. Residual fragments on windows were noted as useful for contamination studies. An ammonia odor in the toilet area intensified in the final week; testing implicated the blower unit rather than the charcoal canister. OWS heat exchanger deficiencies were reported: no upstream filter, vanes covered with lint; crew fashioned a special tool to vacuum condensate and lint, and recommended adding a filter. EVA anomalies included external water leaks and a concern that the PCU composite connector mounting presented a single-point failure and could be pulled off during EVA.

translationJa.summaryJa: 在ポートモレスビー大使館は1985年1月28日、パプアニューギニア国家情報機関（NIO）から1月24日夕刻の高高度・高速機の上空通過に関する非公式照会を受けたと報告した。NIOは点滅する灯火を伴う高速移動物体、コントレイル、騒音などの複数の目撃報告を受け、特にウェワク発ポートモレスビー行きのAir Niugini機のパイロットがアンゴラム上空で南→北に飛行する高高度・高速機をレーダーで捕捉したと述べたという。他に1900現地時刻に北→南方向の1機、2200現地時刻に南→北方向の6–8機の目撃報告がある。大使館は自らの記録と第43戦闘飛行隊（43SW）との電話確認に基づき、同日PNG空域でのB-52上空通過および米国機の存在は確認されないとNIOに伝えたが、提供情報は断片的であり、同省は上記確認および追加情報を求めている。
translationJa.summaryEn: The Embassy in Port Moresby reported on January 28, 1985 that the Papua New Guinea National Intelligence Organization (NIO) made an informal inquiry about reported high-altitude, high-speed aircraft over PNG on the evening of January 24. NIO received multiple reports of unidentified aerial phenomena including fast-moving objects with lights, contrails, and noise; an Air Niugini pilot departing Wewak en route to Port Moresby reported his radar picked up aircraft flying south-to-north at high altitude and high speed over Angoram. Other reports cited one aircraft moving north-to-south at 1900 local and six–eight aircraft traveling south-to-north at 2200 local. Based on Embassy records and a telephone call with the 43rd Strategic Wing (43SW), the Embassy told NIO it had no record of B-52 overflights or any U.S. aircraft in PNG airspace on January 24, and requested confirmation or further information given the sketchy nature of the reports.

               INTELLIGENT CONTROL.

SUBJECT: TAJIK AIR PILOTS REPORT UNIDENTIFIED FLYING OBJECT

1. TAJIK AIR のチーフパイロットである米国市民 ED RHODES と、彼の二人の米国人同僚パイロットは1月29日に報告した。同報告によれば彼らは1月27日、ボーイング747SPで高度41,000フィートを飛行中にカザフスタン上空、北緯45度・東経55度付近で未確認飛行物体（UFO）に遭遇した。彼らが最初に目撃したのは強烈に明るい光で、それは東の地平線上から極めて速い速度で、かつ彼らの飛行高度よりはるかに高い高度から接近してきたものであった。彼らはその物体が円を描き、コークスクリュー状に旋回し、90度の急旋回を非常に高速かつ高いG（重力負荷）で行うのを約40分間観察した。RHODES機長はポケットサイズのOLYMPUSカメラで数枚の写真を撮影し、もし写真が写っていれば大使館と国務省のタジキスタン担当デスク（LOWRY TAYLOR）に送る予定である。しばらくして、その物体は水平の高速航行コースを取り、地平線の向こうへ消えた。

UNCLASSIFIED

PAGE 02     DUSHAN 00259 310310Z
2. 物体観測時は暗かったため、乗員はその形状を識別できなかった。彼らは発した光を「ボウウエーブ（弓波）」のようだと表現し、弾丸飛行時の高速写真に似ていると述べた。すなわち非常に小さな物体がはるかに大きな熱／光の尾を伴っているというものである。最初の目撃から約45分後、太陽が昇る頃に飛行機は物体が残した飛行痕（コントレイル）の下を通過した。機体は500ノット以上で飛行していた。RHODES は、そのコントレイルの高度を約100,000フィートと推定し、そのような極端に高い高度には空気や湿度が極めて少なく、通常の推進機構を持つ航空機が到達し得たとしてもコントレイルを発生させる条件は整わないと指摘した。コントレイルの軌跡は物体の機動、すなわち円やコークスクリュー等を反映していた。

3. 当局が、その物体が地球大気に突入しては跳ね返るような隕石（流星）だったのではないかと示唆したところ、RHODES と乗員は断固として否定した。彼らはPAN AM の旅客機での多年の飛行経験の中で多数の「流れ星」やその他の宇宙ゴミが大気圏に突入するのを見てきたが、今回の目撃は流星とはまったく違うと主張した。速度と機動性に基づき、RHODES は、乗員の支持があるように見えたが、その物体は地球外起源であり知的な制御下にあったという意見を表明した。

4. コメント: 我々は意見を持たず、上記は参考までに報告するものである。

ESCUDERO

translationJa.summaryJa: 在タジキスタン米大使館発の電報（1994年1月31日付）は、タジックエアのチーフパイロット米国人エド・ローズら乗員3名が、1994年1月27日にボーイング747SPで北緯45度・東経55度付近（カザフスタン上空）を高度41,000フィートで飛行中に未確認飛行物体を目撃したと報告している内容を伝える。目撃対象は東の地平線から非常に高高度・高速で接近した強烈な光で、約40分間にわたり円航行、コークスクリュー、90度旋回など高Gでの機動を行った。ローズ機長はポケットカメラで数枚撮影し、写っていれば大使館と国務省に送る予定とした。暗闇のため形状は不明だが、光は“ボウウエーブ”状で弾丸の軌跡に似ると説明された。約45分後に機体がその物体の残した飛行痕（コントレイル）の下を通過し、ローズはコントレイル高度を約100,000フィートと推定、通常の航空機ではその高度でコントレイルを作るには空気/水分が不足すると指摘した。乗員は隕石等による現象ではないと否定し、ローズは速度と機動性から知的制御の地球外起源の可能性を示唆した。電報作成者は意見を付記せず報告として伝えている。
translationJa.summaryEn: A Dushanbe embassy cable (dated Jan 31, 1994) reports that Tajik Air chief pilot Ed Rhodes and two American co-pilots told embassy officials on Jan 29 that they had encountered an unidentified flying object on Jan 27 while operating a Boeing 747SP at 41,000 feet near lat 45°N, long 55°E (over Kazakhstan). The object appeared as an intense light at much higher altitude approaching from the east, and was observed for about 40 minutes performing circles, corkscrews and rapid 90-degree turns under high G. Rhodes took several photographs with a pocket Olympus camera to be forwarded if usable. Darkness prevented visual identification of shape; the crew described the light as having a 'bow wave' like a high-speed bullet with a larger heat/light trail. About 45 minutes after the initial sighting, as sunrise occurred, the aircraft passed beneath contrails the object had left; Rhodes estimated those contrails at roughly 100,000 feet and noted that ordinary aircraft propulsion is unlikely to produce contrails at that altitude. The crew rejected the hypothesis that the phenomenon was a meteor, and Rhodes expressed the opinion—supported by his crew—that the object was extraterrestrial and under intelligent control. The cable itself offers no judgment and reports the crew’s account.

               1. 要旨: 副外相MAMEDOVは10月30日、大使VERSHBOWに対し、ロシア国防省によればジョージア側の主張にもかかわらず、10月28〜29日にKODORI GORGE上空をロシア機が飛行したり陣地を爆撃したりしたことはないと述べた。MFAジョージア課長TEREOKENもMAMEDOVの発言を繰り返した。TEREOKENはさらに、ロシアの軍事装備を満載した貨車1両がGUDAUTA基地を出発して10月29日の朝にロシアに入った（参照A）、および他の貨車2両が積み込まれておりロシア行きのためにアブハジア当局の許可を待っていると確認した。TBILISIが約340名のロシア「警備員」をGUDAUTAに残すことに同意するまで、要員撤退の計画はない。TEREOKENはアブハジア当局が撤収を外部の観察者に立ち会わせることを許さないだろうと述べた。TEREOKENは、議会議長ZVANIAの10月25〜28日のモスクワ訪問を雰囲気は前向きだったが実質的な成果はなかったと表現した。ジョージア大使館によれば、ZVANIAとロシア下院議長SELEZNEVは双方とも非難合戦を避けるべきだと合意した。TEREOKENはまた、国防相SERGEY IVANOVが近くTBILISIを訪問する計画があるとする報道を否定したが、完全には訪問を否定しなかった。要旨終わり。

               2. 10月30日、あらかじめ予定されていた会合で大使VERSHBOWはREFTEL Bの報告（ロシア機がジョージア領空を侵犯しKODORI GORGE地域を爆撃したとするもの）を取り上げた。大使は、そのような事件が事実であり継続するならば米ロ関係にとって壊滅的であり、我が大統領同士の米国で予定されているサミットを台無しにしかねないと強調した。MAMEDOVはそのような事件がサミットに悪影響を及ぼすことを認めたが、ロシア国防省はジョージア領空でのいかなる事件にもロシア機が関与したことを断固として否定していると引用した。

               3. MFAジョージア課長TEREOKENはMAMEDOVの主張を繰り返し、10月30日に我々に対してアブハジアのKODORI GORGEでロシア機が爆撃したという報道を否定した。彼はまたジョージア領空のいかなるロシアによる侵犯もなかったと否定し、10月28日あるいは29日にその地域の近くを飛んでいたロシア機はなかったと述べた。TEREOKENによれば、「テロリストがいた」地域を攻撃したというアブハジアのヘリコプターによる爆撃の信頼できる報告はあったが、その地域の飛行機に関する報告は「UFOの話」でもあるかのようだと述べた。モスクワは当該地域に外国機がいたかどうかを技術的に判断する能力を持っていないと彼は説明した。彼は「誰かを非難しているわけではない」と強調しつつ、「どの側かが」KODORI上空に飛行機を飛ばした可能性はあると付け加えた。

               4. 参照AのGUDAUTAからの撤収計画について尋ねたところ、TEREOKENは軍事装備を満載した列車1編成が基地を出発し10月29日の朝にロシアに入ったと確認した。さらに2編成が積み込まれており、ロシアへ移動するためにアブハジア当局の許可を待っている。ロシア参謀本部のメンバーが

               SUKHUMI TO COORDINATE THESE MOVES.

               5. 我々が撤収を外部の観察者に点検させない理由を尋ねると、TEREOKENは緊張しているTBILISIとの状況を考えるとアブハジア当局が外部者の立ち会いを容認しないだろうと述べた。ロシア側は「最後の瞬間まで」1編成の装備の撤出が行われるとは知らなかったため、外部の観察者を招く時間がなかったとも彼は付け加えた。我々は、もし既に他の2編成を積み込んでおりアブハジアの許可を待っているのならばモスクワには今や時間があるはずだと主張した。透明性の欠如はGORの意図について疑問を招くかもしれないと我々は指摘した。兵力撤収の計画について尋ねると、TEREOKENは約600名のロシア要員がGUDAUTAに残っていると述べた。モスクワはそのうち約340名を「警備」として残すことを主張している。TBILISIはもっと少ない数字を求め続けていると彼は述べた。

               6. 我々はTEREOKENに先週のジョージア議会議長ZVANIAのモスクワ訪問について尋ねた。彼はZVANIAの訪問の雰囲気は前向きだったと確認したが、しかしながらその訪問は「実務的な成果を伴わなかった」と述べた。ジョージア大使館は10月26日に我々にZVANIAの訪問は順調であると伝えた（注：ZVANIAは10月28日にモスクワを出発）。ジョージア政務参事官CHKHEIDZEによれば、ZVANIAとロシア下院議長GENNADIY

translationJa.summaryJa: 要旨: 2001年10月30日、駐ロ米大使ヴェルショウが副外相マメドフと会談した際、ロシア国防省は10月28–29日にコドリ渓谷上空でロシア機が飛行・爆撃したとのジョージア側の主張を否定したとマメドフが伝えた。外務省ジョージア課長テレオケンも同様に否定し、アブハジアのヘリコプターが「テロリストのいる」地域を爆撃したという信頼できる報告はあるが、固定翼機の報告は「UFO」のようだと述べた。グダウタ基地から軍装備を満載した貨車1編成が10月29朝ロシアに入ったこと、さらに2編成が積載されアブハジア当局の許可を待っていることを確認した。撤収の監視についてはアブハジアが外部の立会いを許さない可能性が高く、約600名がグダウタに残留しそのうち約340名をロシアは「警備」として残したいと主張している。議会議長ズヴァニアの10月25–28日のモスクワ訪問は「雰囲気は前向きだが実務的成果はなかった」と評価され、ズヴァニアとドゥーマ議長セレズニョフは非難合戦を避けることで一致した。大使はロシア側否定に懐疑的であり、モスクワがグルジア側とチェチェン関係者への圧力を維持し、グダウタ駐留を交渉カードにしている可能性を指摘している（ケーブル末尾の外交官コメント）。
translationJa.summaryEn: Summary: On October 30, 2001 Ambassador Vershbow met with Deputy FM Mamedov, who relayed that the Russian Ministry of Defense denied that Russian aircraft flew over or bombed the Kodori Gorge on October 28–29, contrary to Georgian allegations. MFA Georgia desk chief Tereoken echoed the denial, saying credible reports exist of Abkhaz helicopters bombing areas “where the terrorists were,” but reports of fixed-wing aircraft were like “UFOs.” Tereoken confirmed one trainload of Russian military equipment departed Gudauta and entered Russia on the morning of October 29; two additional trainloads are loaded and awaiting Abkhaz permission to move. He said Abkhaz authorities likely would not allow outside observers for withdrawals, and that about 600 Russian personnel remain at Gudauta while Moscow insists on leaving roughly 340 as “guards” (Tbilisi seeks a lower number). Speaker Zvania’s Oct 25–28 visit to Moscow was positive in tone but produced no practical outcomes; Zvania and Duma speaker Seleznev agreed to avoid recriminations. Ambassador Vershbow expressed skepticism of Russian denials and commented that Moscow may be using presence at Gudauta as leverage—a judgment included as the cable’s comment.

               Summary


               1. ~ Yes, UFOs. Somehow, over time, the Union of

               UFOiogists of Turkmenabat has established a reputation as
               a reliable NGO partner for a variety of activities from
               assisting with small and medium businesses, to
               distributing humanitarian assistance, to assisting NGOs
               with registering under the 2003 NGO law. The UFOiogists
               have developed a good rapport with local authorities,
               they say, and are able to accomplish their tasks because
               "everyone is interested in UFOs." The UFOiogists next
               initiative is to publish an independent newsletter, the
               first in independent Turkmenistan.

               2. ~ In the appearances-are-deceiving world of
               Turkmenistan, it almost seems fitting that one of the
               USG's most reliable implementers is equally committed to
               looking for life on another planet. End Summary.

               UFOs in Turkmenabat


               3. ~ On November 5, DCM and USAID Director met with
               the Board and interested members of the Union of
               UfOlogists (UOU) of Turkmenabat, Lebap Welayet
               (province). The Union of UFOiogists is working on an
               $8,532 grant to assist other local NGOs navigate the NGO
               registration process of the new NGO law (reftels). The
               UOU was the first NGO to register after independence in
               1992 and was the first independent NGO to reregister
               successfully under the new 2003 NGO law.

               4. ~ Though the Union first was established to
               pursue the study of life on other planets, over time its
               activities became more "practical," Board members told
               the DCM. Members of the Union have attended
               international UFO fora and published on the subject, but
               most members assured the DCM, they had limited or no
               interest in the subject at all. UOU President Ovezberdy
               Muradov said the Turkmen military and government
               authorities had consulted him about mysterious
               occurrences in Turkmen airspace, but he said there had
               been no confirmed sightings of UFOs in Turkmenistan.

               Peace on Earth


               5. ~ Instead, the Union has attracted a local brain
               trust of lawyers, scientists, computer experts,
               accountants, teachers and others who had joined together
               to "do good things." Pointing to their mission statement
               in English, Russian and Turkmen hanging on the wall of
               their office, members assured the DCM that any assistance
               they provided would fit their mission. According to
               their statement, the UFOiogists "help spread the ideas
               about the struggle for peace and human coexistence on
               Earth and in the Universe." Because of their diverse
               activities, the UOU has become an umbrella organization
               with at least nine member organizations running




                                                I  Released in Fulll
UNCLASSIFIED
Sitt,                                                                               Page 2 of 5
 UNCLASSIFIED
Sitt,




               activities from sport, to youth, to business consulting.
               The Union has over 1000 members including some individual
               members from other welayets.

               Registering Small and Medium Businesses


               6. ~ Members told the DCM they first started the
               "practical" side of their work shortly after independence
               by assisting small and medium-sized businesses register
               with local authorities. According to the UOU President,
               during the '90's the Union assisted 187 enterprises in
               registering ranging from farmers unions to joint
               enterprises to a shoe factory. The UOU told the DCM all

               ASHGABAT 00001028 002 OF 002


               this consulting was done pro bono. The Union made money
               over the years, however, by running for-fee computer,
               accounting and other "non-traditional" courses such as
               UFOiogy and massage.

               7. ~ UOU President Muradov told the DCM the Union
               had been successful in this effort because it had the
               respect of local authorities. According to Muradov,
               "everyone is interested in UFOs" and local authorities
               were eager to assist and also learn more about UFOs. The
               Union also regularly ran UFO-related seminars and talks,
               which were well attended.

               8. ~ In addition to commercial work, the UOU
               obtained experience in humanitarian goods distribution
               when it became a partner of the State Department funded
               CHAP humanitarian assistance program administered by
               Counterpart International. UOU facilitated humanitarian
               assistance to refugees from the civil war in Tajikistan
               and also with Afghan refugees. Muradov said the Union
               was eager to continue with such work, should the need
               arise.

               Assisting NGOs


               9. ~ Because of their established track record and
               their success in re-registering after the austere 2003
               NGO law was passed, USAID, through Counterpart
               International, is considering a $15,000 grant to assist
               the UOU with internal capacity building. The grant
               passed the local grants committee and has been forward to
               the regional committee for consideration. The UOU
               already has successfully registered an NGO and is working
               on the registration documents of four others.

               Next, an Independent Newsletter




                                                  IReleased in Fulll
UNCLASSIFIED
Sitt,                                                                                Page 3 of 5
 UNCLASSIFIED
Sitt,




               10. ~ USAID was presented with a grant proposal by
               the UOU for a $30k grant for printing equipment for the
               UOU to establish its own newsletter. Though printing of
               independent media is illegal in Turkmenistan, the UOU
               assured DCM it already had advance approval from local
               authorities because a license was needed for anything
               over 1000 copies and the UOU only planned to publish 999
               copies. UOU members said the content of the newsletter
               would be nonpolitical and only would describe the
               activities of the Union. If members wanted to make
               additional copies, the UOU told DCM, "that is up to
               them." Eventually subscribers would be charged for the
               newsletter, which would then become self-sustaining,
               according to the UOU plan. USAID has requested that the
               UOU submit a stronger, more cost-effective proposal.

               11. ~ The UOU also is considering opening chapters
               in other welayets because "our services are in so much
               demand."

               Comment


               12. ~ Crazy? Like a fox; and worthy of USG
               attention and support. End Comment.

               13. (U) Minimize considered.

               ODdOITl~ E OUT UtdGLAOOIFIED - PLEASE HANDLE ACCORDINGLY

               Summary


               1. ~ はい、UFOです。いつの間にか、トルクメナバトの
               UFO学者連合（Union of UfOlogists of Turkmenabat）は、
               中小企業支援、人道支援の配布、2003年のNGO法に基づく
               NGOの登録支援など、さまざまな活動において信頼できる
               NGOパートナーとしての評判を確立しました。UFO学者連合は
               地方当局と良好な関係を築いていると述べており、
               「誰もがUFOに興味がある」ために任務を達成できると
               言います。UFO学者連合の次のイニシアチブは、独立した
               ニュースレターを発行することであり、トルクメニスタンに
               おける初の独立系ニュースレターになる予定です。

               2. ~ トルクメニスタンの「見かけは欺く」世界では、
               政府が最も信頼している実施者の一つが、別の惑星での
               生命探査に同じく熱心であるというのは、ほとんどふさわしい
               とさえ思えます。要約終わり。

               UFOs in Turkmenabat


               3. ~ 11月5日、代理大使（DCM）とUSAID所長は、
               レバプ州（Lebap Welayet）トルクメナバトのUFO学者連合（UOU）
               の理事会および関心のあるメンバーと会合しました。UFO学者連合は、
               新しいNGO法の下で他の地元NGOが登録手続きを進めるのを支援するために
               8,532ドルの助成金を申請しています（参照欄参照）。UOUは
               1992年の独立後に最初に登録したNGOであり、2003年の新しいNGO法の下で
               再登録に成功した最初の独立系NGOでした。

               4. ~ 連合は当初、他の惑星の生命の研究を目的として設立されましたが、
               時間が経つにつれて活動はより「実用的」になったと理事会の
               メンバーは代理大使に語りました。連合のメンバーは国際的なUFOフォーラムに
               参加し、同分野で出版もしていますが、大多数のメンバーは代理大使に対し、
               実際にはその主題にほとんどまたは全く関心がないと保証しました。UOU会長
               Ovezberdy Muradov は、トルクメン軍および政府当局がトルクメニスタンの
               領空での不可解な出来事について彼に相談したことがあると述べましたが、
               トルクメニスタンでのUFOの確認された目撃はなかったと述べました。

               Peace on Earth


               5. ~ 代わりに、連合は弁護士、科学者、コンピュータ専門家、
               会計士、教師などからなる地元のブレイントラストを引き付け、
               「良いことをする」ために結集しました。事務所の壁に掛けられた英語、
               ロシア語、トルクメン語のミッション・ステートメントを指し示しながら、
               メンバーは代理大使に対し、彼らが提供する支援はすべてミッションに
               合致すると保証しました。声明によれば、UFO学者連合は
               「地球と宇宙における平和と人間の共存のための闘いについての考えを
               広める手助けをする」とされています。多様な活動のために、UOUは
               少なくとも9つの加盟組織を擁する傘下組織となっており、スポーツや青少年、
               ビジネスコンサルティングなどの活動を行っています。連合には他の
               州（welayets）からの個人会員を含め1000人以上の会員がいます。

               Registering Small and Medium Businesses


               6. ~ メンバーは代理大使に対し、彼らが「実用的」な側面の仕事を
               独立直後に開始し、地元当局への中小企業の登録支援を行ったと話しました。
               UOU会長によれば、1990年代には農民組合から合弁企業、靴工場に至るまで
               187の企業の登録を支援したとのことです。UOUは代理大使に対し、
               これらのコンサルティングはすべて無償で行われたと述べました。ただし、
               連合はコンピュータ、会計およびUFO学やマッサージなどの「非伝統的」な
               有料コースを運営することで長年収入を得てきました。

               7. ~ UOU会長Muradovは代理大使に対し、連合がこの努力で成功したのは
               地元当局からの尊敬を得ていたからだと語りました。Muradovによれば、
               「誰もがUFOに興味がある」ため、地元当局は喜んで支援し、またUFOについて
               学びたがっていたとのことです。連合は定期的にUFO関連のセミナーや講演も
               開催しており、それらは盛況だったと言います。

               8. ~ 商業活動に加え、UOUはCounterpart Internationalが運営する
               国務省資金のCHAP人道支援プログラムのパートナーとなった際に
               人道物資配布の経験を得ました。UOUはタジキスタンの内戦からの
               難民やアフガン難民への人道支援を仲介しました。Muradovは、
               必要があれば連合はそのような活動を継続する意欲があると述べました。

               Assisting NGOs


               9. ~ 彼らの確立された実績と厳しい2003年のNGO法の下での
               再登録の成功により、USAIDはCounterpart Internationalを通じて
               UOUの内部能力構築を支援するために15,000ドルの助成金を
               検討しています。助成金は地元の助成委員会を通過し、地域委員会で審査中です。
               UOUはすでにNGOの登録に成功しており、他の4団体の登録書類に取り組んでいます。

               Next, an Independent Newsletter


               10. ~ USAIDはUOUからの助成提案を受け取りました。提案は
               ニュースレターを発行するための印刷設備購入に3万ドルを要求するものでした。
               トルクメニスタンでは独立メディアの印刷は違法ですが、UOUは代理大使に対し、
               1,000部を超える場合は許可が必要であるため、事前に地元当局の承認を得ており、
               UOUは999部のみ発行する予定だと保証しました。UOUメンバーは、
               ニュースレターの内容は非政治的で、連合の活動のみを記述するだろうと述べました。
               追加で部数を作成したければ、それは「メンバー次第」だとUOUは代理大使に
               述べました。最終的には購読者から料金を徴収し、ニュースレターを自立させる
               ことをUOUは計画しています。USAIDはUOUに対し、より堅牢で費用対効果の高い
               提案の提出を求めています。

               11. ~ UOUは「私たちのサービスは非常に需要がある」ため、他の
               welayetsに支部を開設することも検討しています。

               Comment


               12. ~ 狂っている？狐のように狡猾であり、米国政府の注目と
               支援に値する。コメント終わり。

               13. (U) Minimize considered.

translationJa.summaryJa: 在トルクメナバトの市民団体「UOU（Union of Ufologists of Turkmenabat）」は、UFO研究を標榜する団体だが、長年にわたり中小企業の登記支援（1990年代に187件を無償で支援）、人道物資配布（米国務省資金のCHAPプログラムのパートナーとしてタジク・アフガン難民支援）、および2003年NGO法下でのNGO再登録支援など、実務的な活動で信頼を得ている。会員は弁護士、科学者、会計士、教師、コンピュータ専門家らを含む約1,000人、傘下に少なくとも9団体がある。UOU会長オヴェズベルディ・ムラドフは軍や政府から空域での不可解な事象について相談を受けたことがあるが、確認されたUFO目撃はないと述べている。USAID／Counterpartは内部能力構築のための1万5,000ドル助成を検討中で、地域委員会で審査中。またUOUはNGO登録支援用に8,532ドル、ニュースレター印刷設備のため3万ドルの提案を提出しているが、印刷物が1,000部超で許可が必要なため当面は999部発行を計画し、内容は非政治的と主張している。大使館はUOUを有能な実務パートナーと評価し、支援に値するとコメントしている。
translationJa.summaryEn: The Union of Ufologists of Turkmenabat (UOU), though nominally dedicated to UFO research, has built a reputation as a reliable local NGO partner. Its practical activities include assisting SMEs with official registration (reportedly 187 enterprises in the 1990s, provided pro bono), distributing humanitarian aid as a CHAP partner for refugees, and helping NGOs re-register under the 2003 NGO law. The UOU has over 1,000 members, at least nine member organizations, and a membership base of lawyers, scientists, IT specialists, accountants, and teachers. President Ovezberdy Muradov said authorities have consulted him about unexplained airspace incidents but there have been no confirmed UFO sightings. USAID/Counterpart is considering a $15,000 grant for UOU capacity building (under regional review); the UOU has also sought $8,532 for NGO registration assistance and proposed $30,000 for printing equipment to publish a nonpolitical newsletter (planning 999 copies to avoid licensing). The embassy judged the UOU a capable implementer worthy of U.S. government attention and support.

                Subject:           (U) Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, Sep 11-15


               (U) Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, Sep 11-15

               1. ~ This edition of Mission Mexico's Political Blotter features:

                            •   Ebrard Challenges MORENA Election, Threatens to Leave Party
                            • INE Names Commission Members Ahead of 2024 Election
                            • Mexico City Security Secretary Steps Down, Might Run for Mexico
                            City Head of Government
                            • Pablo Vazquez Becomes Mexico City's New Security Secretary
                            • Former MORENA Senate Leader Ricardo Monreal Will Not Run for
                            Mexico City Head of Government
                            • Criminals Targeting and Killing Prosecutors in Guerrero
                            • Guadalajara Mayor Launches Gubernatorial Campaign
                            • Mexican Congress Hears Testimony on Alien Life

               fS8¼::ij Ebrard Challenges MORENA Election, Threatens to Leave Party

               2. ~ Former Foreign Secretary Marcelo Ebrard announced September 11 he
               wou ld cha llenge the results of MORENA's presidential contender selection

                                           Released in Full
                                           John Powers, Acting-Director
                                           US Department of State
                                           2/25/2026


UNCLASSIFIED                                                                                    Page1of7
 UNCLASSIFIED




               process, alleging irregularities. On September 10, Sonora Governor and MORENA
               National Council President Alfonso Durazo formally certified the results of the
               party's selection process; while Durazo indicated he would continue to examine
               Ebrard's complaints, he also indicated he did not assess that the end results
               would change in light of Ebrard's allegations. Ebrard said he expected the
               MORENA Honesty and Justice Committee (responsible for solving intra-party
               conflicts) to hear his challenge, but also added he would "not be interested in
               remaining in MORENA" if the party rejected his allegations. He announced he
               would travel across the country starting September 18 to meet with supporters
               and formalize the creation of a new national political movement. Some outlets
               reported Ebrard created a new political party, but electoral laws would not allow
               this until 2026.

               3. ~ Comment: Having moved on from its contender selection process,
               MORENA is unlikely to validate any of Ebrard's challenges and therefore his
               options seem limited: he could join Citizen's Movement (MC) as its presidential
               candidate (despite some strong opposition within MC, especially from the party's
               Jalisco wing), remain with and create a new "Ebrardista current" within MORENA,
               or join the opposition Broad Front alliance. He cannot form a new party in time
               for the June 2024 elections, and the last day to register as an independent
               candidate (September 8) came and went without his taking action. His latest
               statements and attacks on MORENA's leadership however, increasingly make it
               impossible for him to remain in the party: the party has certified Sheinbaum as its
               candidate, Sheinbaum has embarked on a nationwide tour, and there is no sign
               whatsoever that there will be a do-over of the poll, as Ebrard desires. Ebrard
               retains the support of dozens of MORENA and allied party legislators, but even
               they seem reluctant to leave the party, which limits his leverage. End comment.

               fS8¼:ij INE Names Commission Members Ahead of 2024 Election

               4. ~ The INE council approved the designation of presidents and members of
               key INE commissions September 9 who will oversee the 2024 elections. After a
               contentious session where some councilors seemed at odds on the designations
               (pro-MORENA councilors opposing anti-MORENA councilors, according to
               analysts), INE agreed on the makeup of the commissions that will be in place until
               September 2024. Analysts considered the designations a defeat for MORENA
               because, although its bloc obtained the presidency of key commissions (for




                                          I   Released in Fulll


UNCLASSIFIED                                                                                         Page2of7
 UNCLASSIFIED




               example the auditing commission, tasked with reviewing party expenditures), the
               pro-MORENA bloc still does not have a majority in them. Notably, the complaints
               committee (tasked with analyzing electoral violations and which previously had a
               pro-MORENA majority) now has an anti-MORENA majority.

               fS8t:li Mexico City Security Secretary Steps Down, Might Run for Head of
               Government

               5. ~ After expressing interest in a possible run for Mexico City head of
               government last week (ref A), Mexico City Security Secretary Omar Garcia Harfuch
               resigned September 9, saying in a video he would "collaborate with Claudia
               Sheinbaum, who with her vision and leadership will give continuity to the
               country's transformation." Mexico City's constitution requires officials with a role
               in police forces to step down before the electoral process begins (September 10)
               if they intend to run for public office in the city. Garcia Harfuch leads potential
               MORENA and opposition candidates in almost every poll.

               fS8t:li Pablo Vazquez Becomes Mexico City's New Security Secretary

               6. ~ Mexico City Head of Government Marti Batres announced September 9
               Under Secretary of Citizen Participation and Crime Prevention Pablo Vazquez
               Camacho would replace Garcia Harfuch as Security Secretary. Vazquez has
               worked four years for Mexico City's Secretariat of Citizen Security (SSC). In his
               role as Under Secretary, Vazquez implemented and coordinated violence
               prevention and reintegration programs, including the "Cease Fire" program to
               reduce gun violence and homicides and the "Reconnect" program to prevent
               recidivism in first time criminal offenders, according to media outlets Milenio and
               La Silla Rota. Prior to SSC, Vazquez worked for the federa l Security Secretariat
               (SSPC) and in the then-Prosecutor's General Office. Outside of government, he
               has been a guest criminology professor at the National Institute of Criminal
               Sciences in Mexico City. Vazquez has a bachelor's degree in international
               relations from the Mexico Autonomous Institute of Technology and a master's
               degree in criminology from the London School of Economics and Political Science,
               according to press reports. La Silla Rota reported Vazquez also studied organized
               crime in Sicily and Macedonia.




                                         I Released in Fulll


UNCLASSIFIED                                                                                          Page3of7
 UNCLASSIFIED




               ~ Former MORENA Senate Leader Ricardo Monreal Will Not Run for Mexico
               City Head of Government

               7. ~ After finishing last in the MORENA presidential contender selection
               process and after Omar Garcia Harfuch's resignation and potential entry to the
               Mexico City head of government race, former MORENA Senate Leader Ricardo
               Monreal announced September 12 he would not run for Mexico City head of
               government. Predicting the candidate selection would come down to either
               Garcia Harfuch or lztapalapa Mayor Clara Brugada and noting he had no chance of
               winning the MORENA nod, Monreal said he did not want to cause divisions within
               the party. In a series of interviews, Monreal also said he had no interest in
               serving as a cabinet member in a potential Sheinbaum administration and would
               now focus on teaching, writing, and "hop[ing] for better times." Yet on the same
               day Sheinbaum announced Monreal as her campaign's organization and territorial
               coordinator, and former Interior Secretary Adan Augusto Lopez as her political
               coordinator.

               8. f5ffi:fl Comment: Monreal went from being one of the most powerful figures in
               the ruling coalition to an outcast in only a few years, mostly because of his open
               disagreements with Lopez Obrador. His addition to Sheinbaum's campaign
               despite having a close relationship with her shows he is willing to collaborate,
               although likely in exchange for positions for his close advisors. On September 12,
               media reported Monreal's daughter would run for mayor of Cuauhtemoc, the
               Mexico City borough where Monreal served 2015-2018. Meanwhile current
               mayor of Cuauhtemoc Sandra Cuevas (PRD), who reportedly also has close ties
               with Monreal, is trying to secure the opposition's candidacy for Mexico City head
               of government. End comment.

               ~ Criminals Targeting and Killing Prosecutors in Guerrero


               9. ~ Criminals killed two Guerrero prosecutors within a week's time mid­
               September following attacks against two other prosecutors in July (ref B) and
               August. Criminals assassinated the state delegate of the Federal Attorney
               General's Office (FGR) in Guerrero, Fernando Garcia Fernandez, while he drove his
               vehicle to his office in Chilpancingo September 12. First reports noted armed
               men appeared to coordinate the attack as they shot at Garcia from two
               vehicles. In addition, criminals kidnapped from his home and then killed the




                                          I Released in Fulll

UNCLASSIFIED                                                                                        Page4of7
 UNCLASSIFIED




               recently appointed Guerrero state attorney general's office (FGE) regional
               prosecutor for the Tierra Caliente region, Victor Manuel Salas Cuadras, in Coyuca
               de Catalan September 9, according to Proceso. Security officials found Salas' body
               with approximately 50 gunshot wounds. In a separate late August incident, media
               reported 20 armed commandos kidnapped Patricia Jacqueline Salgado, recently
               appointed as head FGE prosecutor in Coyuca de Catalan. Authorities later located
               Salgado alive but have made no arrests thus far. Interior Secretary Luisa Maria
               Alcalde said during the September 11 presidential press conference there was a
               pattern of attacks against prosecutors in Guerrero in recent months, which was
               related to recent law enforcement arrests and seizures.

               fS8t:ij Guadalajara Mayor Launches Gubernatorial Campaign

               10. f5i:H::li Guadalajara Mayor Pablo Lemus (MC) launched his campaign for Jalisco
               governor during his second annual mayoral address on September 12. "I want to
               ask for your support to build a social and collective project," Lemus announced.
               He called for party unity, and specifically welcomed MC national coordinator
               Dante Delgado's representative despite the rift that emerged in August between
               Jalisco MC and the national party (ref C). Jalisco Governor Enrique Alfaro, Nuevo
               Leon Governor Samuel Garcia, Monterrey Mayor Luis Donaldo Colosio, and other
               MC leaders from Jalisco and Nuevo Leon (the two states MC governs) all attended
               the event. Lemus highlighted the presence of former Jalisco Governor Emilio
               Gonzalez (National Action Party - PAN) and University of Guadalajara (UdeG)
               Rector Ricardo Villanueva (Hagamos, affiliated with UdeG). Polls show Lemus
               holds a commanding lead over rivals from across the political spectrum.

               (U) Mexican Congress Hears Testimony on Alien Life

               11. (U) Congress heard testimony on unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP)
               September 12, from experts including from Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan
               and former U.S. Navy pilot Ryan Graves, who previously testified before the U.S.
               Congress. The hearing was to debate language on UAP in the Aerial Space
               Protection Law which, if approved, would make Mexico the first country to
               formally acknowledge the presence of alien life on Earth. Experts asked
               legislators to recognize UAP, guarantee airspace securit y, and allow UAP to be
               studied. Experts also presented to Congress two alleged alien corpses and videos
               of Mexican pilots' encounters with fast-moving flying objects during flight. After




                                         I Released in Fulll

UNCLASSIFIED                                                                                        Page5of7
 UNCLASSIFIED




               the hearing, Graves lamented the display took away from his and other pilots'
               experiences with UAP and expressed disappointment with Maussan's
               "unsubstantiated stunt." Scientists have discredited previous alleged alien
               corpses Maussan presented as evidence of alien life.




               (U) Figure 1: Mexican journalist Jaime Maussan presented t he alleged remains of non-human beings to
                                                  Congress. (Photo credit: Reuters)

                MRN:               23 MEXICO 2544

                Subject:           (U) Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, Sep 11-15


               (U) Mexico: Weekly Political Blotter, Sep 11-15

               1. ~ この号のミッション・メキシコ政治ブロッターには以下を掲載しています:

                            •   エブラルドがMORENAの候補選に異議、党を離党する可能性を示唆
                            • INE、2024年選挙を前に委員会メンバーを任命
                            • メキシコシティ治安長官が辞任、メキシコシティ長官（Head of Government）選出に立候補する可能性
                            • パブロ・バスケスがメキシコシティの新治安長官に就任
                            • 元MORENA上院院内総務リカルド・モンレアルはメキシコシティ長官に立候補せず
                            • ギレロ検察官らが犯罪組織に標的・殺害される事例
                            • グアダラハラ市長が州知事選挙へ立候補表明
                            • メキシコ議会で地球外生命に関する証言を聴取

               fS8¼::ij Ebrard Challenges MORENA Election, Threatens to Leave Party

               2. ~ 元外相マルセロ・エブラルドは9月11日、MORENAの大統領候補選出結果に
               異議を唱えると発表し、不正があったと主張した。9月10日、ソノラ州知事で
               MORENA全国評議会議長のアルフォンソ・ドゥラソが党の選考プロセスの結果を正式に
               認証した。ドゥラソはエブラルドの申し立てを引き続き検討すると述べたが、エブラルドの
               主張を踏まえて最終結果が変わるとは評価していないとも述べた。エブラルドは、
               MORENAの党内紛争を解決する責任のある「正直さと正義委員会（Honesty and Justice Committee）」
               が自らの異議申立てを審理することを期待すると述べたが、党が彼の申し立てを却下した場合は
               「MORENAに残ることに興味はない」とも付け加えた。彼は9月18日から全国を回り支持者と会い、
               新たな全国的政治運動の結成を正式化すると発表した。複数の報道機関はエブラルドが新党を結成した
               と報じたが、選挙法上これは2026年まで認められない。

               3. ~ コメント: 候補選考プロセスを終えたMORENAはエブラルドの異議を認める可能性は低く、
               したがって彼の選択肢は限られているようだ。彼は市民運動（Citizen's Movement: MC）に入り同党の
               大統領候補になる（MC内、とくにハリスコ派から強い反対があるにもかかわらず）、MORENA内に
               新たな「エブラルディスタ潮流」を残して作る、あるいは野党の広範前線（Broad Front）同盟に加わる
               といった道が考えられる。彼は2024年6月の選挙に間に合うように新党を結成することはできず、
               無所属候補としての登録最終日（9月8日）も彼が何らの行動を取らないまま過ぎた。とはいえ、
               彼の最近の声明とMORENA指導部への攻撃は、党に残ることをますます不可能にしている：党は
               シェインバウムを候補として認証しており、シェインバウムは全国巡回を開始しており、エブラルドが望む
               ような再投票が行われる兆候は全く見られない。エブラルドは多数のMORENAおよび連立党派の
               立法者の支持を保持しているが、彼らでさえ党を去ることに消極的に見え、これが彼の影響力を
               制限している。コメント終わり。

               fS8¼:ij INE Names Commission Members Ahead of 2024 Election

               4. ~ INE評議会は9月9日、2024年選挙を監督する主要なINE委員会の委員長および委員の
               指名を承認した。指名に関して一部の評議員間で対立が見られた（アナリストによれば親MORENAの評議員が
               反MORENAの評議員に反対した）物議を醸す会合の後、INEは2024年9月まで在任する委員会の構成で合意した。
               アナリストは、主要委員会（例えば党の支出を審査する会計監査委員会）の委員長職は親MORENAブロックが
               獲得したものの、親MORENAブロックはそれらの委員会で過半数を持っていないため、これをMORENAの敗北と
               見なした。注目すべきは、選挙違反を分析する苦情委員会（以前は親MORENAの過半数だった）が現在は
               反MORENAの過半数を持っていることである。

               fS8t:li Mexico City Security Secretary Steps Down, Might Run for Head of
               Government

               5. ~ 先週メキシコシティ長官選に出馬する可能性に関心を示した後（参照 A）、メキシコシティ治安長官
               オマール・ガルシア・ハルフチは9月9日に辞任し、ビデオで「国の変革の継続を彼女の視野と指導力が
               もたらすクラウディア・シェインバウムと協力する」と述べた。メキシコシティ憲法は、同市で公職に立候補する
               意図がある場合、警察組織に関与する職務の者は選挙プロセス開始前（9月10日）に辞任することを要求している。
               ガルシア・ハルフチはほとんど全ての世論調査で潜在的なMORENA候補および野党候補をリードしている。

               fS8t:li Pablo Vazquez Becomes Mexico City's New Security Secretary

               6. ~ メキシコシティ長官マルティ・バトレスは9月9日、国民参加・犯罪予防担当副長官
               パブロ・バスケス・カマチョがガルシア・ハルフチの後任の治安長官になると発表した。バスケスは
               メキシコシティ治安局（SSC）で4年間勤務している。副長官として、バスケスはメディア
               （MilenioおよびLa Silla Rota）によれば、銃犯罪と殺人を減らすための「停戦（Cease Fire）」プログラムや、
               初犯の再犯を防ぐ「リコネクト（Reconnect）」プログラムなど、暴力予防と再統合プログラムを実施・調整した。
               SSC以前は連邦治安省（SSPC）や当時の検察総局で勤務していた。政府外では、メキシコシティの国立刑事科学研究所で
               犯罪学の客員教授を務めたことがある。報道によれば、バスケスはメキシコ自治工科大学で国際関係学の学士号を、
               ロンドン・スクール・オブ・エコノミクス政治学部で犯罪学の修士号を取得している。La Silla Rotaは、
               バスケスがシチリアとマケドニアで組織犯罪を研究したとも報じた。

               7. ~ MORENAの大統領候補選考プロセスで最下位となり、オマール・ガルシア・ハルフチの辞任と
               メキシコシティ長官レースへの参入の可能性を受けて、元MORENA上院院内総務リカルド・モンレアルは
               9月12日にメキシコシティ長官に立候補しないと発表した。候補選がガルシア・ハルフチかlztapalapa市長の
               クララ・ブルガダのどちらかに絞られると予測し、MORENAの指名を得る見込みがないと述べ、党内に分裂を
               引き起こしたくないと語った。一連のインタビューでモンレアルは、潜在的なシェインバウム政権で閣僚を
               務めることにも関心はなく、今後は教職、執筆に専念し「より良い時代を望む」と述べた。それでも同日、
               シェインバウムはモンレアルを自身のキャンペーンの組織・地域連絡責任者として発表し、元内務長官
               アダン・アウグスト・ロペスを政治調整責任者として発表した。

               追放者のような立場に転落した。その主な理由はロペス・オブラドールとの公然たる対立である。シェインバウムの
               キャンペーンに加わったことは、彼が協力する意思を持っていることを示すが、おそらくは近しい顧問らのポジションを

               9. ~ 犯罪組織は9月中旬に1週間の間にグアナフアト州（注：原文は Guerrero）で2人の検察官を殺害した。
               これは7月（参照 B）と8月に他の2人の検察官に対する攻撃があったのに続くものだった。グアナフエロ（原文は Guerrero）の
               連邦検事総局（FGR）州代表フェルナンド・ガルシア・フェルナンデスは、9月12日にチルパンシンゴへ車で出勤中に
               暗殺された。最初の報告では、武装した男たちが2台の車両からガルシアに発砲し、攻撃を連携して行ったように
               見えたと伝えられた。さらに、別の検察官が自宅から誘拐された後に殺害されたと報じられた。

最近、グエレロ州検察庁（FGE）のティエラ・カリエンテ地域の地域検事に任命されたビクトル・マヌエル・サラス・クアドラスが、Procesoによると9月9日にコユーカ・デ・カタランで（発見された）。治安当局はサラスの遺体を約50発の銃創で発見した。別件の8月下旬の事件では、報道は20人の武装コマンドーが、コユーカ・デ・カタランで最近FGE検事長に任命されたパトリシア・ジャクリーン・サルガドを誘拐したと伝えた。当局は後にサルガドを生存した状態で発見したが、これまで逮捕者はいない。ルイサ・マリア・アルカルデ内務長官は9月11日の大統領記者会見で、最近数か月間グエレロ州の検察官に対する攻撃のパターンがあり、これは最近の法執行当局の逮捕や押収と関連していると述べた。

               governor during his second annual mayoral address on September 12. "I want to

               He called for party unity, and specifically welcomed MC national coordinator
               Dante Delgado's representative despite the rift that emerged in August between
               Jalisco MC and the national party (ref C). Jalisco Governor Enrique Alfaro, Nuevo
               Leon Governor Samuel Garcia, Monterrey Mayor Luis Donaldo Colosio, and other
               MC leaders from Jalisco and Nuevo Leon (the two states MC governs) all attended
               the event. Lemus highlighted the presence of former Jalisco Governor Emilio
               Gonzalez (National Action Party - PAN) and University of Guadalajara (UdeG)
               Rector Ricardo Villanueva (Hagamos, affiliated with UdeG). Polls show Lemus
               holds a commanding lead over rivals from across the political spectrum.

10. f5i:H::li グアダラハラ市長パブロ・レムス（MC）は、9月12日の第2回年次市長演説の中でハリスコ州知事選への立候補を表明した。「私は社会的で集合的なプロジェクトを築くために皆さんの支持をお願いしたい」とレムスは発表した。彼は党の結束を呼びかけ、特に8月にハリスコ州MCと全国党との間に生じた対立にもかかわらず、MC全国コーディネーターのダンテ・デルガドの代表を歓迎した。ハリスコ州知事エンリケ・アルファロ、ヌエボ・レオン州知事サミュエル・ガルシア、モンテレイ市長ルイス・ドナルド・コロシオ、及びMCが統治するハリスコとヌエボ・レオンの他のMC指導者らもこの行事に出席した。レムスは、元ハリスコ州知事エミリオ・ゴンザレス（国民行動党 - PAN）やグアダラハラ大学（UdeG）学長リカルド・ビリャヌエバ（Hagamos、UdeG系）の出席を強調した。世論調査はレムスが政界全体の対抗馬に対して圧倒的なリードを保っていることを示している。

translationJa.summaryJa: 週次政治ブロッター（9月11–15日）：元外相マルセロ・エブラルドはMORENAの大統領候補選出結果に不正があると異議を唱え、党が申し立てを却下すれば党を去る可能性を示唆し、9月18日から支持者巡回で新たな全国運動の結成を目指すと発表した。国家選挙機関（INE）は2024年選挙を監督する主要委員会の構成を承認し、苦情委員会などで反MORENAの過半数が確立されたと報告された。メキシコシティ治安長官オマール・ガルシア・ハルフチが辞任し、候補出馬の可能性が出る中、パブロ・バスケスが後任に就任（経歴や学歴を報道で紹介）。元MORENA上院院内総務リカルド・モンレアルはメキシコシティ長官選には不出馬を表明し、シェインバウム陣営の組織・地域連絡責任者に就いた。グエレロ州では検察官が相次いで殺害・誘拐される事件が発生（被害者としてFGR州代表フェルナンド・ガルシアとFGE地域検事ビクトル・マヌエル・サラスら）、内務相は最近の逮捕・押収と関連する攻撃のパターンがあると述べた。グアダラハラ市長パブロ・レムス（MC）がハリスコ州知事選出馬を表明し、世論調査でリードしている。9月12日に議会で未確認航空現象（UAP）に関する公聴会が開かれ、ジャーナリストのハイメ・マウッサンが“異星人の遺体”とされる標本を提示したが、元米海軍パイロットのライアン・グレーブスはその演出に失望を表明し、科学者らは過去の標本を否定している。
translationJa.summaryEn: Weekly Political Blotter (Sep 11–15): Former foreign minister Marcelo Ebrard announced he would challenge MORENA’s presidential selection results alleging irregularities, warned he might leave the party if his claims are rejected, and said he will tour the country from Sept 18 to formalize a new national political movement. The National Electoral Institute (INE) approved commission memberships to oversee the 2024 elections; analysts noted an anti-MORENA majority now exists on the complaints committee. Mexico City Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch resigned (citing support for Claudia Sheinbaum) and may run for head of government; Pablo Vázquez was named his successor, with media reporting on his SSC and academic background. Former MORENA Senate leader Ricardo Monreal announced he will not run for Mexico City head of government and was named Sheinbaum’s campaign organization and territorial coordinator. In Guerrero, prosecutors have been targeted: FGR state delegate Fernando García Fernández was assassinated, regional FGE prosecutor Víctor Manuel Salas Cuadras was found shot to death, and Patricia Jacqueline Salgado was kidnapped and later found alive; Interior Secretary Luisa María Alcalde said the attacks form a pattern related to recent law‑enforcement actions. Guadalajara Mayor Pablo Lemus (MC) launched a Jalisco gubernatorial campaign and leads polls. On Sep 12, Congress held hearings on unidentified aerial phenomena (UAP); journalist Jaime Maussan presented alleged non‑human remains, former U.S. Navy pilot Ryan Graves criticized the display, and scientists have discredited Maussan’s prior alleged remains.

translationJa.summaryJa: 2025年、約1700時に複数の米国・連邦・州の要員がヘリコプター（コールサイン[CALL SIGN 1]等）で[SITE CODE NAME]西の山岳地帯を捜索した。2141時以降、LP/OPがFLIRおよびNVGで「"super-hot"」と表現するオーブ／光を検出し、[CALL SIGN 1]が複数回迎撃・捜索を行った。オーブは高速で移動・分裂したと報告され、機体付近（約10フィート以内）まで接近した旨や、二つの物体から何かが出現して別方向へ高速移動したとの副操縦士の目撃がある。西・東・南の山上・上空で、4〜6個のオーブが横一列に順次フレアアップ／フレアダウンする群れや三角形配置などが繰り返し観測された。軍用機が同空域で訓練している報告があり、[CALL SIGN 1]は速度差や燃料不足で追跡を断念し約2316時に基地へ帰還した。目撃者はパイロットが録画していたが多くはヘリのFLIR画角外であり、オーブがヘリから分離して軍用機を追ったように見えたと述べている。
translationJa.summaryEn: In 2025, at approximately 1700 hours, US, federal, and state personnel departed the operations center by helicopter ([CALL SIGN 1] et al.) to search the mountains west of [SITE CODE NAME]. From about 2141–2320 hours LP/OP using FLIR and NVG reported an orb described as "super-hot" and [CALL SIGN 1] conducted multiple intercept/search attempts. The orb(s) were reported to move at high speed, split into multiple objects, approach within roughly 10 feet of the helicopter, and a co-pilot reported something emerging from two objects and accelerating in a different direction. Repeated observations recorded swarms and formations of 4–6 orbs flaring up and down in horizontal sequences or triangular arrangements over mountain areas to the west, east, and south. Military aircraft were also operating in the area; [CALL SIGN 1] broke off pursuit due to inability to match speed and low fuel, returning to base at about 2316 hours. Witness 1 noted pilots said they were recording but many sightings were outside the helicopter FLIR camera angle, and that the orbs appeared to break off from the helicopter and pursue the military aircraft.

translationJa.fullTextJa: FBIのFD-302聞き取り記録。2023年10月の記入で、特別捜査官が関係者に聞き取りを行った。聞き取り対象者は、2023年9月の午前9時ごろ、LiDAR試験のデータ取得のため試験場へ向かって東へ走行していたと説明する。複数の車両が隊列で走行しており、GMC AT4やスプリンターバンが後続していた。車両がいくつかのゲートを通過した際、証言者は地平線上に明るい光を見た。光は空中で静止していた後、右へ動き始め、消えた。車両のフロントガラス右上越しに見え、色は明るい白で、消えるまで約10秒間視認できた。事象中、光の大きさは変わらず、距離は10から20マイルほど離れているように感じられた。車両への干渉は認識されなかった。証言者は同乗者に光を指し示したが、相手は違う方向を見ていたため確認できなかった。後に最初の試験場へ到着した際、別の関係者もそれを見たと述べたため、同乗者はその光に対して無関心ではなくなった、という内容である。

“Orbs Launching Orbs”
•   Location: Western U.S.
•   Time of Day: Dusk (on two separate days)

•   Three teams of two federal law enforcement special agents each (USPER1 through USPER6) independently
    describe seeing orange “orbs” in the sky emit/launch smaller red “orbs” in groups of two to four, with three
    being the general consensus. This is stated to have occurred at least five times. Each time, the orange orb
    would appear, launch red orbs, then disappear. The orange orb was only visible for one or two seconds. The
    red orbs would generally move away from the orange “mother” orb in a horizontal path, but in a couple of
    instances, one red orb was stated to move “heading up at an angle,” while another witness stated sometimes
    the red orbs would “swoop down” after being launched from the larger orange orb. These events were
    witnessed by multiple teams from varying locations and vantage points over a two-day period. Due to the
    sequential nature of the events, it is not known whether there was a single orange “mother” orb that released
    the groups of red orbs or whether there were multiple orange orbs at play.
 “Large, Fiery Orb”
•   Location: Western U.S.
•   Time of Day: Dusk                                                                           Artist Rendering

•   Two federal law enforcement special agents (USPER5 and USPER6) witness a glowing orange orb at a distance of
    “approximately 500-600 meters,”* where it was perched close to a rock pinnacle. Size was difficult to determine,
    but it appeared to be similar in size to a “small helicopter cockpit.”** Witnesses were unable to clearly see any
    structure other than the glowing orb, though USPER6 noted that the object “did almost appear it might have had a
    small spindle or something connecting it from underneath to the rock formation.” Witnesses stated that the object
    did not emit any noticeable sound. The object was described as being “similar to the Eye or [sic] Sauron from Lord
    of the Rings, except without the pupil, or maybe an orange Storm Electrify bowling ball.”
•   USPER6 stated the object “seemed to be hovering with zero resistance or movement, or to be suspended…” The
    sighting lasted “about a minute.”

* Measurements later gathered by AARO assess the object to have been ~1050 meters away from the observers.
** Measurements later gathered by AARO assess the object to have been between 12-18 meters in diameter.
     “Dark Kite”                                                                  Red light



                                                                                                       White light
•   Location: Western U.S.
•   Time of Day: Pre-dawn hours                                       Image 1: Recreation of drawing provided by USPER6 of
                                                                      object seen in night vision goggles.
•   Two federal law enforcement special agents (USPER5 and USPER6) observed what is initially thought to be a car traveling
    along a road in a restricted zone. The “car” had two lights (one red and one white) that are about 2 to 3 feet off the
    ground. Agents pursued the “car” and as they got to within a few hundred feet of it, the object suddenly moved off the
    road over the desert without changing its orientation with respect to the observers, i.e., it appeared to move laterally, at
    an estimated speed of 15-20mph. The object didn’t change height and appeared to move with “zero resistance.” The
    object stopped about 100 meters off the side of the road and turned off its lights. USPER6 described the object as a “thin
    line,” from the back whereas the other agent (USPER5) stated that “it almost looked like an ill defined, dark kite shape
    that had some rounded width to the sides.”*

•   USPER6 used night vision goggles (NVGs) to view the object once it had stopped off the road. The agent stated that they
    observed the object for “a split second in the NVGs before the light turned off” and that once the lights were off, a “very
    thin line” remained. The object was estimated to be about 4 feet wide and positioned horizontally to the ground (see
    Image 1). The object then began moving at about the speed of 15-20mph and appeared to “move up in height…, but
    [remain] a flat line.” The agent lost sight of the object after a few seconds.

* In later discussions with AARO, the object is described as being triangular.
                                                                                                               Note: Outline was not

“Transparent Kite”                                                                                            definitive, but location
                                                                                                              of lights stayed in exact
                                                                                                              formation.
•   Location: Western U.S.
•   Time of Day: Pre-dawn hours

•   About 30 minutes after the “Dark Kite” sighting, federal law enforcement special agents
    (USPER5 and USPER6) returned to the same general area with another colleague
    (USPER7) in response to a report of another unauthorized object in the area. Within a few
    hundred meters of the “Dark Kite” sighting, two of the team members (USPER5 and
    USPER6) observed a kite-shaped object with a lighting pattern similar to the object seen
    previously. This object is about 6 meters off the ground, is canted at an angle from lower
    right to upper left (see Image 2), and appeared to be floating slowly with the wind.
    USPER5 was using NVGs when viewing the object and USPER6 used the bare eye.
    USPER7 did not see the object. USPER5 stated that in the night vision goggles, they could
    “vaguely see a bright star or two in the distance through the object, though somewhat
    more faint,” leading them to believe the object was somewhat transparent. After losing
    sight of the object, USPER5 tried using a spotlight to find it again. The witness noted that
    when shining the light around, “at one point my beam went from shining far into the            Image 2: Recreation of drawing
    distance to stopping about 50 yards away on nothing in particular, it just was not             provided by USPER6 of object
                                                                                                   seen with the bare eye.
    projecting into the distance and then it was.” When the witness pointed the light at the
    spot where the light had appeared to be blocked by something, this time the light was
    “projecting into the distance again.” The team was unable to reacquire sight of the object.
